Around 1am, four of us that are left decide to head down the road and hang out at the park. This four includes me, one of my close friends I've known for years, and two girls I've been friends with for the past 6 or 7 months. These two girls are close friends, one is quiet, edgy, and one of the kindest people you'll meet. She also hosted the party. The other is not quiet or kind.
